# laravel_forge_php_versions (Data Source)

Data source for listing PHP versions installed on a Forge server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Retrieve all PHP versions on a server
data "laravel_forge_php_versions" "available" {
  server_id = 12345
}

# Output
output "php_versions" {
  value = data.laravel_forge_php_versions.available.php_versions
}

output "default_php" {
  value = [for v in data.laravel_forge_php_versions.available.php_versions : v if v.used_as_default]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (Number) The ID of the server to list PHP versions from

### Read-Only

- `php_versions` (Attributes List) List of PHP versions on the server (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--php_versions))

<a id="nestedatt--php_versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `php_versions`

Read-Only:

- `binary_name` (String) The PHP binary name
- `displayable_version` (String) The human-readable version name (e.g., PHP 8.3)
- `id` (Number) The PHP version ID
- `status` (String) The installation status
- `used_as_default` (Boolean) Whether this version is the default
- `used_on_cli` (Boolean) Whether this version is used on CLI
- `version` (String) The PHP version identifier (e.g., php83)
